decisions.summary: the picture child opens tiles lazily, sizes the canvas from their headers, then pops, converts, pastes and closes each tile in turn; the pickled bytes dropped once opened
decisions.why: fix 1 of the GM's table verbatim ('decode, paste, free'); same pixels at the same offsets in the same order, so FR-004's byte identity holds by construction

decisions.summary: TILE_WORKERS = 3 beside TILE_MPX with its measurement; max_workers=min(len(boxes), TILE_WORKERS)
decisions.why: fix 2 ('cap simultaneous tile renders at 3'); the min leaves a picture of three tiles or fewer as now (spec edge case); only scheduling changes, so output is unchanged

decisions.summary: RENDER_JOBS = 4 in render_cache; max_workers=jobs or min(RENDER_JOBS, os.cpu_count() or 4); --jobs and jobs= keep their meaning
decisions.why: fix 3 ('cap the post-landing render step at 4 parallel maps'); a cap of 4 is an upper bound, and the min with the core count keeps the existing never-more-than-cores behavior the spec's FR-003 and edge case already settle; --jobs untouched is no narrowing

decisions.summary: TILE_WORKERS and RENDER_JOBS carry a 'NONE: process plumbing' Research claim if claims-coverage asks; impl-drift only where claims-owed says
decisions.why: the project's standing claims machinery applied to two new constants; adds no behavior and narrows nothing

decisions.summary: a picture above the tile cap equals its single render; tile renders alive at once never exceed TILE_WORKERS; regen_pool with no jobs observes max_workers <= RENDER_JOBS; SC-001..SC-004 measured once
decisions.why: each test only fails when a requested fix (or FR-004's byte identity) is absent - enforcement of the request, not scope

decisions.summary: 324-start on unmodified code, 324-end alone at the last commit, perf-report against the start
decisions.why: constitution VI process; measures, decides nothing about what is built
